annual_crop_prior: Maize annually 1May-15Oct; source germination and harvest switches retained; not observed crop rotation

prescribed_vegetation: Forest, heath, urban soil surrogate and wetland retain LAI route; GASST unavailable

heat_initialization.basis: First day and annual2024 mean of the same ERA5 air-temperature series; linear initial profile; no spin-up
